scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Hm? We've met before,
haven't we? Then again,
all Priests begin to look
the same after a while. Ah,
were you one of the ones
to whom I taught Redemptio?
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
嗯？我们以前见过吧？
不过，牧师见多了，模样也就记混了。
啊，你是不是跟我学过舍身取义？

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Ah, you've forgotten, have
you? Well, it's no problem for
me to teach you again. This skill enables you to revive your fallen
Party Members by sacrificing
your own life for them.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
啊，忘记怎么用了？
没关系，再教你一次就是了。
这项技能能以自己的生命为代价，复活倒下的队友。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
^3131FFOh holy and venerable one,
we pray to you. Please show
us your mercy and guide us
with your light. Give us the
strength to walk the path of
love and sacrifice. Redemptio!^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
^3131FF哦，神圣而可敬的主啊，我们向您祈祷。
请赐予我们怜悯，用您的光辉指引我们。
赐予我们力量，让我们行走在爱与牺牲的道路上。
舍身取义！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
There...
You should be able
to perform Redemptio
now. I hope you use it
well on your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
好了...
现在你应该能使用舍身取义了。
希望你在冒险中能好好运用它~

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
I'll always be praying
for your safety. Be careful,
and I hope that you can bring
love and compassion to all
whom you meet in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
我会一直为你的平安祈祷。
旅途小心，也愿你将爱与慈悲带给途中遇见的每一个人。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
I'll always be praying
for your safety. Be careful,
and I hope that you can bring
love and compassion to all
whom you meet in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
我会一直为你的平安祈祷。
旅途小心，也愿你将爱与慈悲带给途中遇见的每一个人。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Please have mercy and
spread your light through
the world. Guide her with
your benevolent wisdom...
Bless her, and may she
be protected by your grace.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
请赐予怜悯，让光辉洒满世界。
用您仁慈的智慧指引她...
祝福她，愿她受到您的恩典庇护。

scripts.text: Whom are you praying for, sister?
scripts.translation: 修女，你在为谁祈祷

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Oh! You startled me!
Whom am I praying for?
Well, I once knew a young,
playful and merry nun who was
also a bit brazen. But I have
many joyful memories of her.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哦！吓我一跳！
问我在为谁祈祷？
我以前认识一位年轻的修女，活泼开朗，爱玩爱闹，还有点冒失。
不过，想起她，尽是些开心的回忆。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
One day, a group of adventurers
came to Prontera Church in hopes of hiring a Priest to accompany
them to ^3131DDGlast Heim^000000. It must have been fate that she was the only
Priest that was available.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
有一天，几名冒险者来到普隆德拉教堂，想雇一位牧师陪他们去^3131DD格拉斯特海姆^000000。
也许是命中注定，当时只有她一人能抽身前往。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
I remember that she was
so determined to join those
adventurers, and we had no
choice but to let her go.
Still, many of us believed
that it was too dangerous...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
我记得，她执意要和那些冒险者同行，我们拗不过她，只好答应。
但许多人都觉得，这一趟实在太危险...

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
I hear that, at first, their
ragtag team was able to
successfully exterminate
a great number of monsters.
But supporting them as a Priest
must have been tough for her...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
听说起初，那支临时拼凑的队伍消灭了不少魔物。
不过，独自担起牧师的支援工作，她一定很辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Then, tragedy struck.
Surrounded by Wanderers,
the adventurers quickly fell
in defeat, one by one. Soon,
the young nun was the only one of the group still standing.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
后来，悲剧发生了。
队伍遭到邪骸浪人包围，冒险者接连倒下，很快就只剩那年轻修女一人还站着。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Alone against impossible
odds, that poor girl had no
choice but to try a desperate
gamble. She began to chant
the ancient holy spell...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
孤身一人，面对毫无胜算的困境，可怜的女孩只能放手一搏。
她开始吟唱古老的神圣咒文...

scripts.text: Ancient spell...?
scripts.translation: 古老的咒文...？

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Yes! ^FF0000Redemptio^000000!
A skill that only the
most talented Priests
can perform! And here she
was, a young nun with very
little experience, trying it!
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
没错！^FF0000舍身取义^000000！
只有天赋出众的牧师才能施展！
可她还是个阅历尚浅的年轻修女，竟也试着用了！

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Redemptio is the last
resort skill that can be
used to nobly save the
lives of others at the cost
of ^3131FFsacrificing your own life^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
舍身取义是最后关头才使用的技能，以^3131FF牺牲自己的生命^000000为代价，舍己救人。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Yes, I remember the days
she wasn't very interested
in studying the Priest and
Acolyte skills. Surprisingly,
she had learned enough to
attempt to cast Redemptio...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
我还记得，她以前对牧师和服事的技能并不怎么上心。
谁能想到，她竟然已经学到了足以尝试舍身取义的程度...

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Miraculously, she succeeded
in reviving her party members.
They quickly used a Yggdrasil
Leaf to restore her life, and they defeated the Wanderers and
returned home safely.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
奇迹发生了，她成功复活了队友。
大家赶紧用天地树叶子救活她，合力击败邪骸浪人，平安回到了家。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Because of this success, she
was promoted to High Priest
despite the many mistakes she
made in the past. Now she travels the world, helping adventurers
in any way that she can.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
虽然过去犯过不少错，但凭着这次功绩，她还是晋升成了神官。
现在，她四处旅行，尽力帮助各地的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
But, well, she'll
always be that spunky
and joyful girl to me.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
不过，嗯，在我眼里，她永远是那个活泼开朗的女孩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, you still haven't
answered my question.
Are you praying for this
nun? And if so, is she
in some kind of danger?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你还没回答我的问题。
你在为这位修女祈祷吗？
如果是的话，她是不是遇到了什么危险？

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Well, a few months ago,
she went on a mission to
^3131FFLighthalzen^000000, a city in the
Schwarzwald Republic. I was
just worried since I haven't
heard from her in a while.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
几个月前，她去了修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的^3131FF里希塔乐镇^000000执行任务。
好一阵子没收到消息，我有些担心。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
I come here to pray for
her everyday, and hope that
she'll come back safely and
share stories of her adventures
with me. Ooh, we'll talk all night long! It'll be so much fun!
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
我每天都来为她祈祷，盼着她平安归来，给我讲讲冒险的故事。
到时候我们能聊上一整夜，一定很开心！

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Goodness, I've been
running my mouth! I'm
sorry to keep you, did you
have somewhere to go? Well,
I'll be praying for your safety~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哎呀，光顾着说话了！
抱歉耽误你，你还有地方要去吧？
我也会为你的平安祈祷~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I go, would you
please tell me the name
of that High Priest you were
talking about? If I see her,
I'll ask her to contact you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我离开之前，能告诉我你刚才提到的那位神官的名字吗？
如果我见到她，我会让她联系你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Oh, thank you! Her name
is High Priest Sorin. Um,
^3131FFMargaretha Sorin^000000. If you
happen to find her, please
let her know that I am
praying for her safety.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哦，谢谢你！
她叫神官索林，嗯，^3131FF玛格丽塔·索林^000000。
要是遇到她，请告诉她，我一直在为她的平安祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Oh, hello~
How are you
doing today?
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
噢，你好~
你今天过得怎么样？

scripts.text: Please teach me ^3131FFRedemptio^000000.
scripts.translation: 请教我^3131FF舍身取义^000000

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Ooh, Redemptio would be
a good skill for you to learn~
It's difficult to cast, but when you succeed, you can revive all
of your defeated Party Members.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哦，舍身取义很适合你学~
虽然施展起来不容易，但一旦成功，就能复活所有倒下的队友。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Of course, the drawback
is that you must ^3131FFsacrifice
your own life^000000 in order to
use the skill. Now, to learn
Redemptio, you must first
learn ^3131FFLevel 1 Resurrection^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
当然，代价就是必须^3131FF牺牲自己的生命^000000。
要学舍身取义，得先掌握^3131FF1级复活术^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Ah, you must
also bring me
^3131FF30 Holy Waters and
20 Blue Gemstones^000000
so you can attempt
to learn the skill.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哦，还得带来这些材料，才能尝试学习：
^3131FF圣水30瓶
蓝色魔力矿石20块^000000

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Um, but if you fail to
learn Redemptio, you'll
lose 1 Holy Water and
1 Blue Gemstone and
you'll have to try it again...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
不过，要是没学成功，就会消耗1瓶圣水和1块蓝色魔力矿石，只能再试一次...

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Praying gives me a
sense of peace and
comfort. Perhaps that
is one of the reasons
why I chose this job...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
祈祷总能让我感到平静与安慰。
或许这也是我选择这份职分的原因之一...

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Ooh, it seems like you've
brought everything that you
need to learn Redemptio.
Are you ready to try it? If you
fail, you'll lose 1 Holy Water
and 1 Blue Gemstone, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哦，学习舍身取义的东西都带齐了。
准备好试试了吗？
记住，失败会消耗1瓶圣水和1块蓝色魔力矿石哦。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Now, please
concentrate and
repeat this special
prayer after me.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
现在请集中精神，跟我一起念这段特别的祷文。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
^3131FFOh holy and venerable one,
we pray to you. Please show
us your mercy and guide us
with your light. Give us the
strength to walk the path of
love and sacrifice. Redemptio!^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
^3131FF哦，神圣而可敬的主啊，我们向您祈祷。
请赐予我们怜悯，用您的光辉指引我们。
赐予我们力量，让我们行走在爱与牺牲的道路上。
舍身取义！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Congratulations!
You successfully
learned Redemptio!
Please remember to only
use this skill in the most
critical situations.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
恭喜，你学会舍身取义了！
记住，只有到了最危急的关头，才使用这项技能。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
Oh no! I'm sorry,
but you failed to
learn Redemptio. Well,
I'll be waiting right here,
so we can try again when
you're ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
哎呀，抱歉，这次没能学会。
我就在这里，等你准备好了，再来试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
If you want to try to learn
Redemptio, please bring
^3131FF20 Blue Gemstones^000000 and
^3131FF30 Holy Waters^000000. Ah, and
you need to learn ^3131FFLevel 1
Resurrection^000000 beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
想尝试学习舍身取义，请带来^3131FF20块蓝色魔力矿石^000000和^3131FF30瓶圣水^000000。
哦，还得先掌握^3131FF1级复活术^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sister Linus]
If you want to try to learn
Redemptio, please bring
^3131FF20 Blue Gemstones^000000 and
^3131FF30 Holy Waters^000000. Ah, and
you need to learn ^3131FFLevel 1
Resurrection^000000 beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯修女]
想尝试学习舍身取义，请带来^3131FF20块蓝色魔力矿石^000000和^3131FF30瓶圣水^000000。
哦，还得先掌握^3131FF1级复活术^000000。

Please have mercy and
spread your light through
the world. Guide her with
your benevolent wisdom...
Bless her, and may she
be protected by your grace.
scripts.translation:

请赐予怜悯，让光辉洒满世界。
用您仁慈的智慧指引她...
祝福她，愿她受到您的恩典庇护。
